steps.title: Ask the borrower to explain each non-customer payer
steps.draft:
DRAFT LETTER — Ask the borrower to explain each non-customer payer
To: Borrower B0024, attention: Chief Financial Officer
Re: Facility monitoring — request for information (B0024)

As part of our routine monitoring of the facility, we have identified items we need to reconcile:
  - 16 times, money sent to 'Northstar Industrial Supply Inc' came back from 'Northstar Industrial Supply Inc' within 35 days as a 'customer' payment of almost the same amount that settles no invoice ($9,049,017 in total) [ref S3-B0024-CIRCULAR_FLOW-916fd5ca]
  - $8,971,724 (5.6% of inflows) came from 'Northstar Industrial Supply Inc', who is not a known customer or obligor [ref S3-B0024-NON_OBLIGOR_PAYER-c4c4ec5f]

Please provide an explanation and supporting documents for each listed payment, including the relationship between you and each payer by 2026-09-17.

This letter requests information to reconcile our records. It does not allege wrongdoing by any party.

[Credit officer], Wells Fargo
[DRAFT — requires approval; synthetic demonstration data]

steps.title: Trace the flows back to their origin
steps.draft:
INTERNAL ACTION MEMO — Trace the flows back to their origin
Case: B0024 · Finding: money from lenders or linked companies is arriving dressed up as customer payments (high confidence)
Action: Trace each listed inflow back to the account it came from.
